capabilities.description: The artifacts in the board with their newest version and its title, newest first.

inputSchema.description: The artifacts in the board, newest first.

account.description: Only the artifacts of this account, by its email address.

for.description: Only the artifacts with a version whose for names this reference, such as /changes/<name>.

limit.description: The most artifacts to return, 1 to 200; 50 when left out.

inputSchema.title: ListInput

capabilities.name: list

Current.description:
An artifact's newest version: its record's path, version id, title and when it was recorded.

`version` is null for a version keyed by its page's hash.
Current.title: Current

Listed.description: One artifact, by its record's path, with its newest version, or null when it has none yet.
Listed.title: Listed

outputSchema.description:
Artifacts, newest first by their newest version, or by `first_seen` for one with no version.

`total` counts every artifact that matched and `truncated` says whether the
limit left some out. `unreadable` counts the artifact and version records
Board marks degraded or this plugin cannot read, which were left out.
outputSchema.title: ListOutput

capabilities.description: Write an artifact record, without a version, for each artifact of an Artifact tool listing that the board does not have.

Listing.description:
The Artifact tool's `list` result, unchanged: `{artifacts, truncated?, total?}` and the tool's other fields.

Only a listing of the account's own artifacts is admitted, so a `scope` of
`shared` or `all` is refused.

artifacts.description: The listed artifacts, at most 200, most recently updated first.

scope.description: Absent in a listing of the account's own artifacts; mine is the same.

total.description: How many artifacts the account has.

truncated.description: Whether the account has more artifacts than the listing holds.

Listing.title: Listing

Row.description: One artifact of the Artifact tool's list result. The tool's other fields are kept out of the record.

title.description: The artifact's title in the listing.

updatedAt.description: When the artifact was last updated, with a time zone.

url.description: The artifact's claude.ai link, such as https://claude.ai/artifact/AbCdEf0123456789xyzQ.

Row.title: Row

inputSchema.description: Record each artifact of an Artifact tool listing that the board does not have.

account.description: The email address of the claude.ai account that published the artifact.

listing.description: The Artifact tool's list result, unchanged. Board reads stdin only when no flag is given, so give the whole input as JSON on stdin: {"account": "owner@example.com", "listing": {...}}.

inputSchema.title: ImportInput

capabilities.name: import

Truncated.description: A listing that left artifacts out: how many it listed, how many the account has, and what that means.
Truncated.title: Truncated

outputSchema.description: The artifact records written, by path, how many the board already had, and whether the listing was cut short.
outputSchema.title: ImportOutput

description: The claude.ai artifacts the owner publishes, each with a copy of every version's page, recorded by the board-artifacts Claude Code mod. Use it to find an artifact, or to sync the artifacts published outside Claude Code. Start with `board --personal call artifacts.list`, which lists the artifacts with their newest version, newest first. SKILL.md and README.md in the plugin's directory say more.
name: artifacts
